article_manifest.title: From Mali to Niger, how is Algeria regaining influence in the Sahel?
article_manifest.original_title: من مالي إلى النيجر.. كيف تستعيد الجزائر نفوذها في منطقة الساحل؟
article_manifest.summary: Algeria seeks to regain its influence in the African Sahel region through military, security and economic movements, at a time of increasing regional and international competition for the region, with the growing presence of Russia, the UAE and Morocco. Foreign Policy magazine confirmed that Algeria is intensifying its moves to regain its security and military influence in the Sahel and Sahara region, in light of the escalation of security threats and the increasing presence of foreign powers seeking to expand its influence in the region.

article_manifest.title: Sahel: violent fighting between the jihadists of Jnim and those of the ISE at the Mali-Burkina border
article_manifest.original_title: Sahel: violents combats entre les jihadistes du Jnim et ceux de l'EIS à la frontière Mali-Burkina
article_manifest.summary: The Sahelian branch of the Islamic State claims to have killed more than 400 Jnim fighters a week ago in Udalan. A claim published this Thursday in Al Naba, the Islamic State's propaganda newspaper. "The balance sheets of the EIS are always false", tempers a West African researcher, a keen connoisseur of jihadist groups Several specialized sources assure that the deaths are numerous on both sides and that Islamic State commanders in the Sahel were killed by Jnim.

article_manifest.title: West Africa: Sahel - Violent fighting between Jnim and ISIS jihadists on the Mali-Burkina border
article_manifest.original_title: Afrique de l'Ouest: Sahel - Violents combats entre les jihadistes du Jnim et ceux de l'EIS à la frontière Mali-Burkina
article_manifest.summary: Since August, there has been significant fighting between the jihadists of Jnim, linked to al-Qaeda, and their rivals the Islamic State in the Sahel (ISIS). These fights are taking place on the border between Mali and Burkina Faso, also not far from the Nigerian border. The last clashes took place at the end of last week, mainly on Friday, October 9 in Gonadaouri, in the Burkinabe province of Oudalan .

article_manifest.title: Sahel: Bloody Battles Between Rival Branches of Al-Qaeda and ISIS
article_manifest.original_title: Sahel: batailles sanglantes entre les branches rivales d’Al-Qaïda et de l’Etat islamique
article_manifest.summary: The two groups, which covet the same geographical areas and seek to control the same roads and local populations, have regularly clashed since 2019. A rivalry that also reveals their constant expansion in the Sahel difficult to stem for the juntas in power in these three countries that form the AES (Alliance of Sahelian States) "This is the most intense direct confrontation on a global scale" between a branch of Al-Qaeda and an organization affiliated with Daesh, according to a report by UN experts sent to the Security Council in early August.

article_manifest.title: West Africa: A war within a war - The clash between JNIM and the Islamic State in the Sahel
article_manifest.original_title: Afrique de l'Ouest: Une guerre dans la guerre - L'affrontement entre le JNIM et l'État islamique au Sahel
article_manifest.summary: Ouagadougou — A war within a war. It is the one that takes place in the sands of the Sahara, in the area of the triple border between Mali, Niger and Burkina Faso, where the two main jihadist groups active in the region clash: Jama'at Nusrat al-Islam wal-Muslimin (JNIM, Group in support of Islam and Muslims) and the Islamic State in the Sahel (ISIS). The former is affiliated with Al-Qaeda, while the latter is linked to the Islamic State.

article_manifest.title: Operation Dougoukoloko: the FAMa strike two terrorist positions near Dioura and Tongolo Coura
article_manifest.original_title: Opération Dougoukoloko : les FAMa frappent deux positions terroristes près de Dioura et de Tongolo Coura
article_manifest.summary: Through the exploitation of precise intelligence, the Malian Armed Forces targeted two sites attributed to terrorist groups on 14 and 15 October 2026. These actions are part of the dynamics of surveillance, control and security operations in the national territory . Bamada.net-The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) continue their operations in different theaters of intervention in order to strengthen the security of the national territory and reduce the nuisance capacities of armed terrorist groups .

article_manifest.original_title: Al-Qaeda and IS rivalry sparks fierce fighting across Sahel
article_manifest.summary: Jihadists from rival Al-Qaeda and Islamic State factions in the Sahel have clashed recently on an unprecedented scale in the borderlands spanning Burkina Faso, Mali and Niger, with claims of hundreds of fighters killed. The two extremist coalitions, which covet influence over the same areas and control of the same routes and local populations, have repeatedly clashed since 2019.
